entities.name: RNA polymerase omega
observations: 82-residue protein; exact sequence match to curated Synechococcus sp. CC9902 Q3AZJ0.
Promotes bacterial RNA polymerase assembly by latching the N- and C-terminal regions of the beta-prime subunit and facilitating interactions with beta and alpha subunits.
Contains Pfam RNA_pol_Rpb6 domain PF01192.28 at residues 25-74.
The omega subunit is not itself the catalytic polymerase component; catalytic activity belongs to the assembled RNA polymerase complex.

source_tools.relevance: Exact sequence match, curated function, and Pfam domain

entities.name: RNA polymerization
observations: DNA-directed RNA polymerase reaction: RNA(n) + ribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate -> RNA(n+1) + diphosphate.
Mapped to Rhea RHEA:14527, RHEA:17342, and RHEA:21248; this reaction is catalyzed by the assembled RNA polymerase complex, not independently by the omega subunit.

source_tools.relevance: Candidate catalytic reaction associated with curated homologs

entities.name: RNA_pol_Rpb6
observations: Pfam PF01192.28 detected at positions 25-74 in the query sequence; supports RNA polymerase omega/Rpb6 family assignment.
